environment.description: ASP.NET Core 7.0 API deployed on AKS (Kubernetes 1.28) behind Azure Application Gateway with custom rewrite rules. The cluster runs Thales Luna Network HSM 7.x client via PKCS#11 provider with partition-level access policy requiring dual-control activation. The HSM partition policy (policy template ID 23) enforces that all CKM_RSA_PKCS signing operations require the calling identity's CN field in the client certificate to exactly match one entry in the HSM partition's pre-registered operator list (stored as raw ASCII, no Unicode, max 64 bytes per entry, rejecting any byte > 0x7F). The PKCS#11 session establishment itself fails with CKR_USER_NOT_LOGGED_IN if the authenticated identity presented via mTLS contains any non-ASCII octets after the Application Gateway's TLS termination re-encodes the client-cert Subject CN using the partition's ASCII-strict validation. Additionally, the Kubernetes NetworkPolicy restricts pod egress to only the HSM appliance IP on port 1792 (NTLS), and the pod's service account has no Azure RBAC roles.

config.mtls_enforcement: Application Gateway TLS termination with client cert forwarding
config.network_policy: egress restricted to HSM appliance IP:1792 only
config.azure_rbac: no roles assigned to pod service account
